name: BMTC Group Inc.
summary: BMTC Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates a retail network of furniture, household appliances, and electronic products in Canada. The company operates through Tanguay and Real Estate divisions. It serves its products through Tanguay stores and Tanguay L'Entrepôt stores, as well as through distribution and administrative centres in Montreal and Quebec City. BMTC Group Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
